CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Steven W. Huang, DDS, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Tony Chou, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

Calvin Lo, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Steve Talt, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 27, 2024 AT 8:30 AM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00
  p.m. the day before the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will
  be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00

   p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council
  at the meeting.
  Written public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Talt, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  MISSION STREET BEAUTIFICATION PROJECT DISCUSSION

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council direct staff to proceed with
  the final design and bidding of the project to include the elements selected by Council
  for the beautification of the Mission District. If the Council concurs, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to approve the following elements: complete sidewalk replacement and
  installation of street tree lighting (and/or any other options that may be selected by
  Council) to be included in the final design of the project, and direct staff to proceed
  with the final design and bidding of the project.”

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 27, 2024  PAGE 2 of 5
   CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. O-24-1413 AMENDING MUNICIPAL
  CODE  SECTIONS  14.18.07 (MAINTENANCE)  AND 23.16.03
  (DEFINITIONS) AND ADDING MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 23.16.24
  (PROHIBITION ON ARTIFICIAL TURF AND GRASS) TO PROHIBIT
  ARTIFICIAL TURF AND SYNTHETIC GRASS IN THE CITY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt Ordinance No. O-24-
  1413. If the City Council agrees, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to adopt Ordinance No. O-24-1413, an Ordinance of the San Marino City
  Council amending Municipal Code Sections 14.18.07 and 23.16.03 and adding
  Municipal Code Section 23.16.24 to prohibit the installation of artificial turf and
  synthetic grass in the City.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF CONTRACT RENEWAL FOR PLAN CHECK SERVICES
  WITH VANDORPE CHOU ASSOCIATES, INC. (VCA)

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve the contract and
  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the contract renewal for VCA and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the agreement.”

 4.  AUTHORIZE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE MEMORANDUM OF
  AGREEMENT WITH SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS
  (SGVCOG) FOR PARTICIPATION IN THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY
  REGIONAL FOOD RECOVERY PROGRAM

  Recommendation: Staff recommend that Council authorizes the City Manager to
  execute the Memorandum of Agreement between the San Gabriel Valley Council of
  Governments and the City of San Marino for participation in the San Gabriel Valley
  Regional Food Recovery Program.

  “I move to authorize the City Manager to execute the Memorandum of Agreement
  between the San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments and the City of San Marino
  for participation in the San Gabriel Valley Regional Food Recovery Program.”

 5.  APPROVAL OF AMENDMENT #1 TO THE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE
  IMPERIAL COUNTY OFFICE OF EDUCATION AND THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO FOR THE PROVISION, INSTALLATION, AND MAINTENANCE
  OF ADVANCED NETWORK (DATA) SERVICES AT THE CROWELL PUBLIC
  LIBRARY

AGENDA – SEPTEMBER 27, 2024  PAGE 3 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the Amendment #1 to the
  Agreement between the Imperial County Office of Education and the City of San
  Marino for the provision, installation, and maintenance of advanced network (data)
  services at the Crowell Public Library. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the Amendment #1 to the Agreement between the Imperial
  County Office of Education and the City of San Marino for the provision, installation,
  and maintenance of advanced network (data) services at the Crowell Public Library,
  and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.”

 6.  ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-24-26, UPDATING THE CONFLICT
  OF INTEREST CODE OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Resolution No. R-24-26
  updating the Conflict of Interest Code of the City of San Marino. If Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to adopt Resolution No. R-24-26, updating the Conflict of Interest Code of
  the City of San Marino.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  CLOSED SESSION

The City Council will recess to closed session to discuss:

 1.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION
  GOVERNMENT CODE 54956.9 (D)(2)

  The City Council is meeting with respect to three (3) matters of significant exposure
  to litigation against the City; one related to CalHDF (letter received is attached), one
  related to CalRecycle, and one for which no further disclosure is required at this time.

 2.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – INITIATION OF LITIGATION
  GOVERNMENT CODE 54956.9 (D)(4)

  litigation by the City.

3.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION
  GOVERNMENT CODE 54957 (B)

  Title: City Manager

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
